definitions: To socialize with the same group of people.
To have the same social acquaintances and friends.
examples: They always move in the same circles.
It's not surprising they know each other; they move in the same circles.
Even after all these years, we still move in the same circles.
lemma: to move in the same circles
synonyms: to run in the same circles
to travel in the same circles
source: to move in the same circles
